source_specific_limitations: Individual source book pages not checked for all index-only entries

Lexicanum has citation warnings and wiki updates may alter canon interpretation
This atlas is not an exhaustive record of every named world
Name-only additions from faction indexes do not establish a planet environmental profile
Craftworlds are mobile, artificial habitats and must not be plotted as fixed natural planets
